fusions.name: Rehearsed Descent
fusions.desc: Sends a flight of locusts into the first enemy it meets for 6 damage, then on to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 100% of that. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Flawless Stripping
fusions.desc: The swarm strips every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 28 damage. Every hit is a critical hit, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Schooled Cloud
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds. For 10 seconds, an escort of locusts fights beside you, striking for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Counted Bites
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 10. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: a blow strikes that enemy for 27% of your weapon damage per stack (272% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
